name: zsnd_play_handle_update3d_directsound
description: zSndPlayHandle::Update3D updates a DirectSound backend buffer from cached or supplied 3D source state.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification was attempted with vc5_o2_ob0_facs, vc5_o2_ob1_gx_facs, vc5_o2_ob1_md_gx_facs, vc5_o2_ob2_facs, and vc5_o2_ob2_gx_facs; the closest profiles were vc5_o2_ob2_facs and vc5_o2_ob2_gx_facs with 673 unmasked mismatches against the 811-byte original.

VC5SP3 fallback byte verification was attempted with vc5_o2_ob0_facs, vc5_o2_ob1_gx_facs, vc5_o2_ob2_gx_facs, and vc5_o2_oy_ob0_facs; the closest profile was vc5_o2_ob2_gx_facs with 679 unmasked mismatches.
tier S remains open because all reviewed VC profiles produce substantial x87/control-flow/source-shape differences.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x4a2b40 rejects non-backend handles, missing backend buffers, disabled spatial source flags, and guarded owner samples before provider updates.

The native smoke verifies the no-listener path, muted attenuation, listener-relative pan and distance attenuation, Doppler frequency scaling, far-distance silence return, DirectSound SetPan and SetVolume error returns, and unsupported Update3DDispatch fallback.

The smoke uses a typed DirectSound buffer vtable double for GetFrequency, SetFrequency, SetPan, and SetVolume, matching the indirect calls at vtable slots 0x20, 0x44, 0x40, and 0x3c observed in Binary Ninja.
